item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-08-11
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 过去 24 小时，Nervos Talk 整体并不平淡：CCC 2.0.0 预发布帖成为讨论热点，多个 Spark 项目出现新进展，Fiber 也出现了新的跨链构想。[S02, S01, S15, S20, S13] 围绕 CCC 的预发布，开发者们延伸出关于 AI 辅助编程时代个人判断力的讨论，涉及 AI 幻觉、编码疲劳等话题。[S03, S04, S05, S07] 此外，Spark 生态中有项目发出资金释放请求和新提案，也有项目开始了针对新用户的可用性测试。[S15, S20, S01] ## 重点话题 **CCC 2.0.0 预发布与 AI 编程讨论**：Hanssen 发布了包含 CoBuild、Coin 和 CKBC(oin) 的 CCC 2.0.0 预发布帖，并坦言正式版可能要到明年才能发布。[S02] 回复区里，有用户提到 AI 让人越来越容易说“我能”，但也要求回答“为什么是我”；有用户强调“不要相信 AI 生成的任何东西，要让它提供依据”；还有人觉得编码变得更累、更无聊，并建议开发者给 AI 设置个人护栏、把它当作头脑风暴伙伴。[S03, S04, S05, S07] **多个 Spark 项目更新**：Cell Sandbox 在重新设计后开始对不熟悉 CKB 的用户做可用性测试，想验证新人能否走通 Journey、Cell Lab、Transaction Explorer 和 Build 等流程。[S01] CKB Builder Lab 项目请求释放 70 万 CKB 资金。[S15] 新提案 Spark Verify...

item.title: Spark Program | Cell Sandbox — A Visual Playground for the CKB Cell Model (1 posts)
item.description: Weekly Sync: Usability Testing Hi everyone, Following the redesign in commit 7e49599, this week I’ll focus on testing the new flow with people who are unfamiliar with CKB. I want to see whether newcomers can move through Journey, Cell Lab, Transaction Explorer, and Build & Test without extra guidance. I’ll note where they get stuck, which terms are unclear, and whether they understand how transaction inputs and outputs are handled. Anyone new to CKB is welcome to try the live demo and share feedback in this thread. I would also like to ask the committee to process my previous funding request for the work completed so far.

item.title: CCC 2.0.0 Prerelease - CoBuild, Coin 和 CKBC(oin) (7 posts)
item.description: 本文不代表任何组织。同时发表在我的个人博客上。 我失败了。 从现在看，说不定我真的会像半年前担心的那样，等到明年才发布 CCC 2.0.0 版本。 「阅读 CCC 里 UDT 相关的工具。请帮我制定一份重写相关逻辑的方案。」 CCC Logo1512×567 80 KB Coin 硬币的概念已经存在了上千年，在人类社会中承担着价值流通的职责。在 CKB 上，我们也有数字版本的硬币，即后来被称为 UDT 的寻常代币。每一枚硬币都由 CKB 上的一个 Cell 承载，由类型脚本约束着代表硬币面额的数据。一枚硬币可以拆分成多枚，多枚也可以组合回一枚，而每一枚又都可以在不同的地址中流通。 CKB 有两种货币资产，分别是原生代币和硬币。原生代币几乎是必须支持的类别，但处理原生代币相关的问题，例如最小占用费，却需要消耗开发者大量的心力。而当开发者终于准备支持硬币时，周边基础设施的缺失又让能完整支持硬币的生态应用少之又少，光是在链下实现简单的收付款就是一种挑战，更别说复杂的链上逻辑。 因此，在这次以硬币为主题的预发布里，我决定重写旧的 UDT 包，抛弃很多原来没设计好的部分。同时，我也决定用 Coin（硬币）这个旧名字代替不够直观的 UDT，因为它在社会中有着更广泛的共识，也更能直观体现 CKB 上寻常代币有着独立面额的特点。 CKBC(oin) 新的 Coin 包试图为应用简化硬币操作，而 CKBC(oin) 则试图将硬币的概念也拓展到原生代币上。对于只关心货币资产价值的应用，CKBC 的存在能让它们不再需要分别处理原生代币和硬币，从而降低应用的开发门槛。 在 CKBC(oin)...

item.title: Pay Lightning with Fiber: a self-hosted Cross-Chain Hub anyone can run (2 posts)
item.description: Hey everyone, Lightning is already huge. Millions of people, wallets, and merchants live there. Fiber is just getting started. That gap is the real problem. If Fiber only works inside Fiber, growth stays slow. If someone on Fiber can pay a Lightning invoice - and someone on Lightning can move value the other way - Fiber suddenly plugs into a network that already has users, habits, and demand. That’s what a Cross-Chain Hub (CCH) is for. In plain English: a CCH is a bridge between Fiber (Nervos) and Bitcoin Lightning. It swaps value between the two without a custodial middleman holding your money. You run the hub. You keep the keys. Fiber already has the pieces for this. What’s hard is...

item.title: Spark Program | Spark Verify - Reproducible Acceptance Checks for CKB Projects (1 posts)
item.description: Repository: Akane-CN/spark-verify Requested funding: $1,000, paid in CKB Timeline: 6 weeks 1. Project overview Spark Verify is an open source command-line tool and a small verify.toml format for CKB projects. A project author describes a local devnet flow and the results that should be observed, such as whether a transaction commits or is rejected, which Cells exist after the run, whether a balance changed as expected, and how many CKB-VM cycles a script used. A reviewer runs one command and receives a pass/fail result with a structured evidence report. The goal is to make the “How to Verify” section of a CKB project easier to run and repeat.
